cases.description: A Position that has only an entry trade (isOpened() == true) should return zero() for getGrossProfit(). The entry trade is a BUY at price 10 with amount 1.

A Position that is closed (isOpened() == false) but whose internal 'exit' trade reference is null. Calling getGrossProfit() should attempt to access exit.getPricePerAsset() and throw a NullPointerException.

A Position that is closed with a non‑null exit trade, however the exit trade's price per asset is null. When getGrossProfit() invokes getGrossProfit(exit.getPricePerAsset()), the null argument propagates and results in a NullPointerException inside the overloaded method.
